### The Data Science Union (DSU)

#### External Project Lead

Led a group of 8 undergraduate data scientists in completing a project about private company valuation using AI. Our client is a M&A advisory platform that helps companies sell their business, so we created a script to automate the valuation process for our client.

![Tech Investment Bank Client Project](DSU_External_Project.pdf){width="640px" height="480px"}

#### Data Analyst

Performed Stock Price Anomaly Detection and Forecasting using a Hidden Markov Model, STL Decomposition, and ARIMA forecasting, training the model on stock data from July 2024 to the end of September 2024.

![Stock Price Anomaly Detection and Forecasting](curriculum_project.pdf){width="640px" height="480px"}

### DataResolutions at UCLA (DataRes)

#### Director of DataTeach

DataTeach is a committee dedicated towards teaching high schoolers data science. I reconstructed the committee after overseeing recruitment, outreach, and curriculum development. Created a comprehensive 8-week curriculum on Jupyter notebook and pioneered a YouTube series as supplement. Also hosted a Computer Vision workshop for the broader UCLA community

Check out the YouTube channel [here](https://www.youtube.com/@DataTeachatUCLA/playlists)

![Computer Vision Workshop](computer_vision.pdf){width="640px" height="480px"}

#### DataBlog Journalist

[Analyzing Longevity Across the World](https://ucladatares.medium.com/analyzing-longevity-across-the-world-42d43e992866)

This project involves using a random forest model to predict longevity and its influential features. We analyzed the relationship between aspects of different countries (CO2 emissions, healthcare spending, GDP, etc) and their corresponding life expectancies.

[What Are Successful Spotify Songs Made Of?](https://ucladatares.medium.com/what-are-successful-spotify-songs-made-of-3571bee2f510)

Project exploring the songs that are successful on Spotify and what the common trends are between them.
